Published

Sep 02, 2026 at 01:36 PM EDT

Marni Rose McFall

Reporter

President Donald Trump’s approval rating among Hispanic Americans has climbed this summer, raising the question of whether he is beginning to rebuild a key part of the coalition that helped power his 2024 victory. [...] The president’s popularity differs across the country.

According to Civiqs' online polling, as of late August, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 percent disapprove.
